source.title: Firefighter Hand Anthropometry and Structural Glove Sizing: A New Perspective
source.definition: Appendix A, journal page 1375 (PDF page 17): width at the first proximal knuckle from the base of the finger, measured from a flat hand scan
source.population_limit: US firefighters measured in 2009-2012, not a universal male or individual fit guarantee

design_reason: Use the reported 24.4 mm male sample mean plus 0.3 mm each side, giving a 25 mm minimum opening. This is a small inward adjustment from R11, requested after viewing it. The grid and printed edge reach leave 25.4 mm centred clearance, with side-key centres at X +/-23.0 mm. The clearance remains an agent-selected allowance, not a personal fit measurement.
implementation: Derive side-key spacing from the actual printed seat/floor inner reach and a quarter-millimetre grid. Check a full rectangular 25 mm opening above the rod crown against the final carrier and bought-part references. Retain compact inner load paths and the original interfaces.
